title.pending: Your stall is waiting for approval

reviewing.title: An admin is reviewing your registration.
reviewing.text: You will get a notification and an email when it is approved. Until then your stall and products are not visible to customers.

now.title: What you can do now
now.details: Fill in your stall details, the markets you sell at, your days and pickup windows.
now.pin: Pin your stall on the map so customers can find you on day one.
now.products: Products can be added once the stall is approved. Prepare names, prices and photos in the meantime.

again.title: Apply again
again.text: You can send a new registration with updated details or evidence.

running.title: Orders already placed still run
running.text: Customers who ordered before the suspension keep their orders (D-09). Mark them ready and completed as usual so nobody loses what they reserved.
